content.title: Watch ABC live with Fubo
content.text: Frequently Asked QuestionsWhat is Fubo?Fubo is a service that broadcasts live TV over the internet, no cable required. Watch your favorite teams, network shows, news and movies on 200+ channels. Plus on-demand entertainment including full TV series.Can I watch soccer leagues live with Fubo?Yes! Fubo networks broadcast Champions League, MLS, Ligue 1, Liga MX and many other leagues and tournaments.How can I watch the NFL online without cable?To watch the NFL without cable, just start a free trial of Fubo. You can start watching immediately on your TV, phone, computer and more. There's no contract.Does Fubo have channels like ABC, CBS and FOX?Yes, Fubo has ABC*, CBS* and FOX* as well as ESPN, MTV, VH1, SHOWTIME, FX, Comedy Central and Disney Channel among others. *Regional restrictions apply.What are some shows I can watch on Fubo?Fubo gives you live and on-demand access to top shows like Survivor, The Simpsons, Abbott Elementary, Bob's Burgers, The Bachelor, Shark Tank, 9-1-1, Yellowstone, Saturday Night Live, Tucker Carlson Tonight, The Rachel Maddow Show, The Conners, Family Guy, Atlanta, The Masked Singer, Law & Order: SVU, Billions…the list keeps growing.Are leagues like the NFL, NBA, MLB and others available?Absolutely! Not only does Fubo have the NFL, NBA and MLB, but you can also watch NHL, NASCAR, MLS, golf, tennis, boxing, MMA, college sports and more. Plus, we have every golf major, tennis major and Triple Crown race as well as full coverage of specials like the Super Bowl, World Series, NBA Finals, Stanley Cup Playoffs and Olympics.Is Fubo available where I live?Fubo is currently available in the United States, Canada and Spain. Packages and pricing differ per country.How can I watch college football online without cable?To watch college football without cable, just start a free trial of Fubo. You can start watching immediately on your TV, phone, computer and more. There's no contract.Can I record games & shows?Yes, all U.S. Fubo plans include unlimited Cloud DVR space for recording all your favorite sports, shows, movies & news at no extra charge. Hit record on one device and watch that recorded content on another. Recorded content will be available in your library for nine months.How much does Fubo cost?Prices vary based on your plan, region and selected add-ons. Our most popular plan in the United States includes 200+ channels of live sports and TV for half the cost of the average monthly cable bill.Can I watch ESPN Unlimited with Fubo?If your Fubo base plan includes the ESPN channel then ESPN Unlimited is now included at no extra cost. Just activate ESPN Unlimited through your Fubo account or invitation email and start streaming via the ESPN app or website.How do I activate ESPN Unlimited from my email?Fubo subscribers on eligible plans will get an email invite, which will include an "Activate Now" link, and instructions on how to or sign into a MyDisney account. That’s it — you’re set to watch ESPN Unlimited.How do I activate ESPN Unlimited from the Fubo website?Log in at fubo.tv and click on the Settings gear. Click My Account and then Subscription. If you're on an eligible plan, you’ll see the option to activate ESPN Unlimited. Just follow the prompts to set up your MyDisney account and unlock ESPN Unlimited access instantly.Where can I watch ESPN Unlimited content?Some Fubo plans, like Fubo Sports, have ESPN Unlimited content available right inside the Fubo app. Other Fubo plans, like Fubo Pro, give you acess to ESPN Unlimited content on the ESPN app or website. Just log in using your MyDisney credentials.Do I have to sign a contract?No. Fubo is strictly on a month-to-month or quarterly basis. Your subscription will automatically renew until you choose to cancel your account in your profile.What if I want to cancel?We’d hate to see you go, but we understand. That's why we've made it easy. Cancel online anytime without paying fees.What devices can I watch Fubo on?You can watch Fubo on your computer, iPhone, iPad, Android phone and tablet, Roku, Apple TV, Chromecast, Xbox consoles and Amazon Fire TV.Can I stream shows on my TV?Yes. The easiest way to watch Fubo on your TV is with a Roku, Apple TV, Amazon Fire TV or Chromecast. Simply install the Fubo app on your device to stream on your TV.How many devices can I simultaneously watch on?Fubo can be actively streamed on two devices at the same time. Need a third stream? Add Family Share to your account for an additional $5.99/mo.After signing up, where can I find help if I have questions about my account/service?For technical questions or getting help with your account, visit the Fubo Help Center to find answers and contact us.Still have questions? Expert help, just a click away.For technical questions or getting help with your account, visit our Help Centerto find more answers and contact us.Agent hours of availability: 10:00 AM - 10:00PM ET - 7 days a week. Holiday hours may vary.
